summary: test_instrument can be added to both fixture cdylibs as a real instrument class (independent VST3 IEventList/ProcessContext + CLAP note/raw-MIDI/transport translators, MAX_VOICES triangle synth with 2400-frame release/CC7/CC1 tremolo/PPQN-960 transport click oracle) and exercised through the production L1 out-of-process path without touching production adapter translation/DSP layers

Slice start: VST3 instrument.rs+events.rs+InputSurface+CLASS_ROWS table (10 classes); CLAP instrument.rs+instrument_core.rs+block.rs translators (4 plugins); host_path + l1_real_test_plugin_e2e additions both crates; CLAP host.rs MIDI/transport forwarding; plugin-core wire record codec + host/export migration

DSP law: up to MAX_VOICES triangle voices at 440*2^((key-69)/12) Hz via f64 semitone table, u64 Q32.32 phase advanced once per frame, waveform from top 24 fraction bits in [-1,1]; NoteOn retriggers same key / first inactive / steals oldest, velocity==0 acts as NoteOff; NoteOff arms fixed 2400-frame linear release every time; CC7=master volume u32 scale-to-max default u32::MAX, CC1=tremolo depth; mix=Σ triangle*velocity*envelope * gain*volume*tremolo(4Hz tri LFO) + click, identical on all channels

Transport click law: playing+musical timing emits one-sample 0.5*volume impulse at next PPQN boundary strictly inside block; tick->frame via exact i128 ceiling division; each block derives clicks from own transport snapshot so loop/seek/chase are driven purely by delivered state; stopped= silent; CLAP fixes CLAP_PPQN=960, VST3 normalizes host projectTimeMusic ppq to 960 ticks

VST3: TestComponent gains InputSurface::ParamsOnly|MidiTransport; instrument component uses MidiTransport so collect_block_events also drains IEventList MIDI kinds and block_transport projects ProcessContext; factory countClasses 8->10 with CLASS_ROWS table + class_row helper consolidating the 3 getClassInfo* variants; INSTRUMENT_CONTROLLER_CID added (gain-mirror ParamController)

CLAP: block.rs gains translate_instrument_event (structured note events + raw MIDI 1.0 -> EventKind::Midi, Match::All/out-of-range/non-finite/unsupported = defined skip) and transport_from_clap (CLAP transport snapshot -> TransportInfo, CLAP_PPQN=960, timing flags validated); plugin.rs/lib.rs add 4th descriptor org.ruviform-test.clap-test-instrument features instrument/synthesizer/stereo

Production host bridge (CLAP only): host.rs push_midi_event encodes neutral EventKind::Midi -> structured note events for NoteOn/NoteOff (PCKN channel+key concrete, port/note-id Match::All) and raw MIDI 1.0 bytes for CC/pitch-bend/poly-pressure/channel-pressure/program-change; TransportInfo projected into CLAP transport snapshot; VST3 adapter unchanged (existing IEventList/ProcessContext forwarding exercised by fixture-owned events.rs)

L1 wire defect found: event slot is fixed EVENT_WIRE_SIZE=33 stride but encode_event emits variable-length records (MIDI=28 bytes) — parent staged at 33-byte stride leaving stale tails (debug_assert fired) and child decoded as packed stream; MIDI through L1 was never exercised before. Fixed at wire-contract owner: plugin-core/src/wire.rs gains encode_event_record/decode_event_record (zero-pad to 33, nonzero padding + malformed rejected); host l1/data.rs staging and export decode moved to record codec; slot stride and event-count semantics unchanged

L1 oracle law: delivered blocks lag source calls by lookahead (2)+drain so phase assertions use latency-margin windows where all possible source calls share one phase; pipeline writes defined silence on underrun so sounding blocks are identified by out[0]==-1.0 retrigger extreme; silence checks use s==0.0 IEEE compare because CC7=0 yields -0.0; NoteOff sent exactly once then empty blocks because fixture law re-arms the 2400-frame release on every NoteOff; offset-gating asserts out[offset]==-1.0 plus bit-identical post-offset segments without assuming pre-offset silence (voice sustains into next block)

Debug session: initial CLAP release-tail failure traced to test re-sending NoteOff every block (release_left froze at 2336=2400-64, re-armed each block) — fixture law correct, test fixed to single NoteOff; -0.0 vs +0.0 bit-pattern false negatives fixed with IEEE ==0.0; translate_instrument_event/NoteOff mapping verified at fixture level, host push_events verified emitting all MIDI kinds, block-level translation test added — root cause was test oracle, not bridge
